description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on end wall. Seating: Sofa in upper-left living area facing inward toward the room; additional seating around dining table near kitchen. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: households needing significant storage (no wardrobes or storage room); people working from home requiring a desk space; larger families needing more than two bedrooms; those wanting a dedicated dining-TV entertainment setup.
